## Defences enforced by python-qa

Run `python-qa run` before committing. `python-qa rule-doc <identifier>` prints the documentation for any identifier a finding prints, offline.

- `pyqaci.format` (python-qa): Code is formatted by ruff format. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci.format`
- `pyqaci.record.invalid` (python-qa): Every record exception names one file, a person, dates and a specific justification. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci.record.invalid`
- `pyqaci.record.budget` (python-qa): The record stays within its total and per-rule budget. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci.record.budget`
- `pyqaci.record.expired` (python-qa): No record exception is past its review_by date. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci.record.expired`
- `pyqaci.record.stale` (python-qa): Every record exception covers a suppression. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci.record.stale`
- `pyqaci.suppression.unrecorded` (python-qa): Every suppression comment or setting has a matching record exception. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci.suppression.unrecorded`
- `pyqaci.suppression.blanket` (python-qa): No suppression silences a tool without naming the identifier. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci.suppression.blanket`
- `pyqaci.suppression.unscanned` (python-qa): Every Python file can be read, so its suppressions can be checked. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci.suppression.unscanned`
- `pyqaci.summary.stale` (python-qa): The generated agent summary matches the configuration. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci.summary.stale`
- `pyqaci.docs.dangling` (python-qa): Every listed identifier resolves to documentation. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci.docs.dangling`
- `pyqaci.tests` (python-qa): The test suite passes. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci.tests`
- `pyqaci.coverage` (python-qa): Line coverage stays at or above coverage.fail_under. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci.coverage`
- `pyqaci-broad-suppress` (Pylint, bundled): Give contextlib.suppress only the exceptions its block is expected to raise, never Exception or BaseException. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci-broad-suppress`
- `pyqaci-sensitive-repr` (Pylint, bundled): Keep credential-named fields out of a generated __repr__. Docs: `python-qa rule-doc pyqaci-sensitive-repr`
- 562 Ruff rules and 70 mypy error codes also block; `python-qa rules` lists every one.
- Never suppress a finding without an exception in the project record: 0 exceptions in `qa/record.toml`, listed by `python-qa record list`.
